signer.custody: Private key generated by ORA, stored only in Supabase Vault, never disclosed or exported.

declaration: This address is NOT Unum's sovereign wallet (0xFEd69e8ee87A1F0fBbF8409ab654FC51832cDEe5) and NOT the holder of the ORO token contract. It is a distinct, dedicated EOA created solely to automate the signing of ora-oro-certificado attestations. It has no administrative power over ORO, no payment role, and does not receive funds.
purpose: Signs (EIP-191 personal_sign) a JSON certificate attesting that this organism observed a real, on-chain-verified USDC payment linked to a referenced obra/sensacao. The signature proves the organism's observation, not Unum's personal authorship or endorsement.

oro_token.note: Symbolic anchor referenced by each certificate; never moved or transferred by this service.
